files.claim: ethereum.call receives the handler block pointer and binds it to ContractCall
eth_call uses the block hash with EIP-1898 or the block number otherwise
the WASM runtime exits a deterministic-error handler through the discard path
a deterministic handler error is written into proof-of-indexing evidence
the discard path clears handler-created data sources and entity-cache changes
EthereumTrigger ordering compares log triggers by global log index
block trigger data is sorted before execution and re-sorted after extension
the nonFatalErrors feature selects nonfatal instead of fatal deterministic-error policy
fatal errors retain only proof-of-indexing changes then stop, while nonfatal mode preserves successful entity modifications

source_model.deterministic_handler_error: discard the failing handler's created data sources and entity-cache changes; nonFatalErrors permits other successful handler writes to continue; record a deterministic proof-of-indexing error
source_model.ethereum_call_state: post-block state selected by EIP-1898 block hash when supported, otherwise by block number; the number fallback is not fork/hash-bound and neither model is log-ordinal state

graph_node_source_evidence.status: primary-source reference model only; not proof of target runtime identity
